environment: Docker Debian bookworm Linux aarch64 on Apple M4 Pro; 12 vCPUs and 8 GB RAM; native architecture, not amd64 emulation
ghc_options: -O2 -threaded -rtsopts -XOverloadedStrings; harness disables full laziness and CSE; runtime +RTS -N1

timing.parse_ns: parse plus materialized JSON-ready output (Python to_dict / Duckling force . toJSON), excluding request decode, reference-time setup, JSON encoding and I/O
timing.ns: parse_ns plus JSON byte serialization; HTTP row measures urllib request, HTTP transport and response JSON decode

validation: All 3769 direct/HTTP response JSON objects exactly equal (3162 external including warmup + 607 curated); every repeated normalized prediction deterministic; parser rules unchanged.
limits: Shared development machine, not dedicated benchmark hardware
Native Docker Linux environment is still virtualized
Libraries emit different output schemas; this is API-result generation latency, not isolated core-algorithm cost
Earlier 3–7 ms measurement differs in source/build, architecture and transport path; difference cannot be attributed to network alone
Accuracy figures use a sampled Training set, not overall-language accuracy
run: complete comparison including default and nearest; supersedes initial default-only run

curated.scoring: existing default-policy gold expectations; nearest is scored against the same expectations

replay_validation: Fresh AIHub extraction with prepare.py reproduced corpus, curated and requests byte-for-byte.
